item.title: Azure Wireguard Setup
item.description: Getting Started This a guide on how to setup a VPN server in a go check this out an Azure instance and connect to it via WireGuard. One server is enough for 5-7 people comfortably, so once set up, feel free to share you configs :). You will need azure credits to avail VPN services through the azure wireguard setup. For this, you need to create an azure account (using a student Microsoft Account - link, you get 100$ worth of free credits), which enables you to create a virtual machine server.
